limitations: Selection diagnostic rows exist only on new-scout hint paths with >=1 hint; existing scout, empty hints, failed fallback, exhausted path budget and32-row cap can leave no detailed row.
HintCount is a waypoint-hint count. Different observers can see the same objectId; only the chosen hint ID is recorded, so distinct candidate monster counts cannot be reconstructed.

activeOtherWaypointCount is a count of distinct eligible declared same-map waypoints after active/alive/20s/24ACK filters. Nullable unevaluated counts do not establish absence of other scouts or fighters.

Hint selection-to-action links use bounded next recorded rows and declared scenario coordinates. They do not reconstruct unrecorded snapshots, failed/deferred targets, targetClaims or actual internal pursuit lifetimes.
The available wire rows have only their reported connection counters; this diagnosis does not reconstruct either fighter owner/peer candidate snapshots or perform per-request900ms dual-packet replay.
